Post · Library Experience

My Journey to the Top:
Discovering the University Library

A visit to Building I, Floors 9 & 10 — and everything I learned.

"I was totally blown away!"

As a sophomore mostly buried under lab reports and cell biology diagrams, I rarely ventured to the upper floors of Building I. But thanks to this assignment, I finally made my way up to Floors 9 and 10 — and it felt like walking into a massive, cozy universe of knowledge right in the heart of campus.

To unlock the library's full services, students must first activate their library account. The librarians walked me through every step:

1
Identity Verification

Present your student card to the librarian at the front desk.

2
Data Sync

The librarian processes and syncs your data into the central management system.

3
Full Access Unlocked ✓

Physical borrowing and the entire digital portal are now active.

Once activated, a whole new world opens up — including the massive VNU-HCM Central Library digital database: international papers, e-books, and premium journals available anytime, anywhere.

I also asked about library skills training. Free workshops are regularly held, covering reliable sourcing, smart search keywords, and citation tools like EndNote. Register early via the notice board or library website!

I even borrowed a thick biology book just to test the system — it worked perfectly. This visit completely changed how I see the library: it's not just a quiet exam hideout. It is our ultimate academic wingman.

🏛 Building I · Floors 9 & 10

A massive knowledge hub at the heart of the VNU-HCM University of Science campus.

🔓 Account Activation

Bring your student card to the front desk — instantly unlocks both physical borrowing and the full digital library.

📚 VNU-HCM Digital Database

Free access to international papers, e-books, and premium journals — anytime, anywhere.

🎓 Free Skills Workshops

Learn reliable sourcing, smart keywords, and tools like EndNote. Register via notice board or library website.

💡 Key Takeaway

The library is far more than a study spot — it's a gateway to global academic resources, and librarians genuinely want to help.

The library isn't just a place to study — it is the place where a student's full academic potential begins to unlock.
— Nguyễn Huỳnh Minh Khuê, after her first library visit

Academic Experience

My Laboratory Journey

Turning textbook theories into real science, one experiment at a time.

01

⚗️ General Chemistry Lab

Precision & Saponification

Mastered lab safety and precise measurement through hours of titration. A highlight: learning the saponification reaction — the chemistry of turning oils into soap, from scratch.

02

🔬 General Biology Lab

Microscopy & Anatomy

Trained in microscope use to observe cell structures and tissue slices. Also performed frog dissection to explore real anatomy — unsettling at first, but absolutely fascinating once you see it.

03

🧫 Microbiology Lab

Sterile Technique & Gram Staining

My absolute favourite. Mastered full sterile protocol to prevent contamination, plate streaking to isolate bacterial colonies, and Gram staining to classify bacterial species under the microscope. Pure science joy.

Beyond the Lab

Life Outside Science

The passions that keep me grounded, energised, and fully human.

🍳

Cooking & Grocery Shopping

My creative therapy. Walking through market stalls, handpicking fresh ingredients, planning a healthy menu on a budget — it's all incredibly grounding. Cooking is chemistry you can eat: a beautiful blend of patience, creativity, and care. It's my favourite language of love.

🚴

Cycling & Fitness

When my mind gets too loud, I get on my bicycle. I track every route and effort on Strava — watching numbers become proof of hard work is its own reward. Cycling gives me total freedom: wind, open road, and silence. My private space to clear my head and build inner strength.
